name: VibeSys bespoke agent-built engine on 4x MI300A: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B MXFP4 goodput 2242 tok/s @96sess
unit: tok/s goodput (aggregate over 96 concurrent sessions, SLO-bound)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (SyFI Lab, UW, blog 2026-10-08). 4x AMD Instinct MI300A (gfx942, 128GB HBM3 shared CPU+GPU per package, 512GB node). Model Qwen3.5-397B-A17B MXFP4 (amd/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-MXFP4, ~17B active, 512 routed experts, hybrid 15 attn + 45 Gated-DeltaNet linear layers). Multi-turn chat benchmark, concurrency ramp 1->192 sessions, 3-6 turns x 80-300 gen tokens, full history resent each turn. GOODPUT = output tok/s for responses meeting SLO (p95 TPOT<=250ms, p95 TTFT<=10s). AGGREGATE over concurrent sessions. Engine: bespoke agent-built serving engine (~19.4k LOC, prefix cache w/ DeltaNet snapshots, HIP-graph decode, fused MXFP4 MoE, MTP w/ 2 draft tokens @84% accept). Peak at 96 sessions; 2.33x the tuned-SGLang baseline on the same 4x MI300A node.
notes: Filed under engine_id=vllm only because there is no 'vibesys-bespoke' engine record and vllm is the closest serving-engine class; the actual engine is a one-off agent build — see source. MI300A's unified HBM3 lets weights, KV, DeltaNet state, OS page cache and host share 128GB/pkg.
